note: SKUniform of iOS 8 and the SKNode subscript of iOS 8: the value class and its iOS 8 surface. The members that arrived in iOS 10 and the deprecated floatVector/floatMatrix aliases are owed. SKNode's iOS 7 surface is in ios7.json and its iOS 9 move in ios9.json. The rest of SpriteKit (SKAttribute and SKAttributeValue of iOS 9, SKShader, the renderer, the other nodes) has no row yet.
